title: Lifting Platforms – Anywhere, Anytime, For Every Job
lines: Need a lifting platform? Ofek and Tal Cranes.
Scissor lifts, boom lifts and spider lifts.
Lighting, signs, facade painting and air-conditioning.
Offices, warehouses, malls, halls and synagogues.
Petah Tikva, Rosh HaAyin, Kfar Saba and Tel Aviv.
Haifa, Jerusalem, Netanya, Holon and all the way to Eilat.
Anytime – even at night, when the place is empty.
Worker harnessed in the basket, barriers around, and a ground man always.
For every task, every job – big or small.
Ofek and Tal – lifting platforms anywhere, anytime.
